newsitem.title: USA: Computer Management Sciences names pres/COO.
newsitem.headline: Computer Management Sciences names pres/COO.

text.p: Computer Management Sciences Inc said Monday it has named R. Halsey Wise as president and chief operating officer.
The appointment is effective Aug. 18, it said.
Most recently, Wise was vice president of corporate finance at Robinson-Humphrey Co Inc.
In the president's post, Wise succeeds Jerry Davis, who remains chairman and chief executive. The chief operating officer's position is newly created, a company spokeswoman said.
CMSI provides information technology, consulting and custom software development services.
